title: Masonry walls.
officialText:
The fire-resistance rating of masonry walls shall be based upon the equivalent thickness as calculated in accordance with this section. The calculation shall take into account finishes applied to the wall and airspaces between wythes in multiwythe construction. FIRE-RESISTANCE PERIODS OF CLAY MASONRY WALLS

or between members set in from opposite sides, shall not be less than 93 percent of the thickness shown.

gross cross-sectional area measured in the same plane.
